app.openInTelegram: Open the admin panel via the bot in Telegram.

user.ownRole: You cannot change your own role.
user.protected: Main administrator (ADMIN_TELEGRAM_ID) — role cannot be changed.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

chats.empty: The bot has not been added to any group yet. Add it to a group (or a channel discussion group) as an administrator allowed to delete messages.

chat.noDelete: The bot cannot delete messages, so moderation does not work.
chat.noRestrict: The bot cannot restrict members, so the mute action will only delete the message.

links.description: Deletes messages with links, except allowed domains.

stop_words.name: Stop words
stop_words.description: Deletes messages with forbidden words. Case-insensitive. A trailing asterisk matches word beginnings: spam*
